milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the light_blue_carpet patch. The carpet occupies spawn-relative coordinates (5,0,-9) to (9,0,-6), so the center target is (7, 0, -7). max_distance=16 allows the player to 'find' it from a reasonable viewing distance across the courtyard, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the carpet, confirming visual identification rather than just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_wall_sign drops a 'dark_oak_sign' item into the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so any dark_oak_sign present (min_count=1) confirms successful mining. No special tool is required — signs break instantly with bare hands.
